newsitem.title: USA: Nash Finch completes United-A.G. deal.
newsitem.headline: Nash Finch completes United-A.G. deal.

text.p: Nash Finch Co said Wednesday it completed the acquisition of United-A.G. Cooperative Inc, a cooperative wholesale grocery distributor based in Omaha, Neb.
The purchase was for cash and included United-A.G.'s distribution center in Omaha, Nash Finch said. Additional terms were not disclosed.
United-A.G. had $200 million in revenues last year. It served about 100 member-owned stores in Nebraska, Kansas, Iowa, Colorado and South Dakota, Nash Finch said.
Operations from Nash Finch's existing distribution center in Lincoln, Neb., will be consolidated into the Omaha center, the company said. Consolidation plans will begin taking effect immediately.
